entries.title: Psalms 43:1
segments: ¶Be my judge, O God, supporting my cause against a nation without religion; O keep me from the false and evil man.

entries.title: Psalms 43:2
segments: You are the God of my strength; why have you put me from you? why do I go in sorrow because of the attacks of my haters?

entries.title: Psalms 43:3
segments: O send out your light and your true word; let them be my guide: let them take me to your holy hill, and to your tents.

entries.title: Psalms 43:4
segments: Then I will go up to the altar of God, to the God of my joy; I will be glad and give praise to you on an instrument of music, O God, my God.

entries.title: Psalms 43:5
segments: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God, for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.
